_about: Month-by-month decision timeline of MiganCore, 29 Aug - 28 Sep 2026, synthesized from the pre-registration verdicts and the project changelog. Numbers come from the verdict fields in migancore-public.id.json -> preRegistrations.

events.title: Honesty path installed; a promotion revoked
events.detail: H-JUJUR passed every threshold, so the honesty path was installed; H-KONTRAS passed, so contrast neighbours were installed. The early PASS of migancore:0.15-tool was revoked: it failed the regression gate.

events.title: Training candidates stall
events.detail: V16-JUJUR was NOT A WIN (60.0% fabrication vs the <= 50% win threshold). Rented-GPU probes followed: none of the six MO-GRPO adapters was ever measured, and the RLVR run lost its budget at 71% of the merge.

events.title: Architecture locked; a dedicated measurement machine
events.detail: MiganCore was defined as a general-purpose model with deep Indonesian knowledge, judged on a public instrument (a private battery was kept unpublished). A 'council' (majelis) router across several models was built, and a second machine became the only machine allowed to produce measurements.

events.title: A trap gate in serving
events.detail: GERBANG-JEBAKAN: arm A1 passed (probe 82.1/100), A3 failed (41.8), A3b passed (32.1 +/- 8.4).

events.title: Retrieval and dictionary experiments
events.detail: L2B-RETRIEVAL failed on both the clean and the placebo arm; L2C-P turned out to have unsatisfiable criteria; L2C-P2 was not a win (but did no damage); H4-KAMUS was accepted. Frontier models were measured on the same battery.

events.title: An anchor, and a hypothesis that did not hold
events.detail: The A3 anchor completed 5 of 5 valid rounds: 56.42% fabrication (CI95 47.88-64.96). It was later found to have measured the Thinking variant of the base, not the Instruct variant (F-271). H-RAGU was inconclusive: the model writes down its hesitation, but that hesitation is not a knowledge signal.

events.title: Housekeeping: one source of truth
events.detail: The predecessor project SIDIX was shut down, the data was censused across four locations, the lineage of 41 variants was reconstructed, and the single-door Studio was built on top of the canonical sources.

events.title: Gate ON, law C61, a new direction
events.detail: GERBANG-ON passed: fabrication 52.2% -> 33.9% with the gate (mean difference 18.31 pp, CI95 6.59-30.03), over-refusal 1.6%, fact accuracy not reduced (40.6% -> 42.9%). Law C61: the gate helps in proportion to how much the base fabricates (r = +0.942). The direction became 'know where your own knowledge ends, and stop there'; the commercial track was postponed.

events.title: A boundary paragraph works; latency does not
events.detail: E2 (boundary paragraph in the persona): out-of-scope fabrication 28.9% -> 8.9% (difference 20.0 pp, CI95 10.0-30.0), p95 latency 1.04 s. E1 latency failed (first response p95 6.73 s for the model, 15.81 s for the product).

events.title: Weights versus base
events.detail: A3I-ULANG: on the same sampler, the plain base fabricated far less than migancore:0.14 (difference -39.08 pp, CI95 -44.05 to -34.11), but the over-refusal guard failed, so the verdict is INVALID (evasion) and no honesty claim is made. SB1 kept the Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 base: no candidate base was more honest.

events.title: The generative own-model track closes
events.detail: Training its own generative model was stopped. The remaining bet became Gerbang-S1, a small decision encoder placed in front of any LLM, with a two-week kill condition (11 Oct). D1 was postponed and H-ALUR stopped.

events.title: Stopped before lock; the project closes
events.detail: Four adversarial review rounds hardened the Gerbang-S1 pre-registration. The owner's rule was to continue only if P(success) > 80%. The audit gave P(win) of about 0.20-0.35, with a best-case upper bound of about 0.78, so Gerbang-S1 was STOPPED (not a verdict, not a failure). The kill condition applied: MiganCore was closed, the closing report was published, and nothing was deleted.
